title: Randomized controlled trial to evaluate the impact of the RheumaFit exercise app on quality of life, pain, physical function, and health literacy in patients with rheumatic diseases
summary:
Regular physical activity helps people with rheumatic diseases reduce pain and stay mobile, but knowing how to exercise safely at home can be challenging. The RheumaFit research project was designed to address this issue. In this scientific study, we are testing a specially designed smartphone app used alongside a smart fitness watch. The app provides participants with a personalized exercise plan tailored to their individual needs, which can be adjusted by their medical team. Meanwhile, the smartwatch automatically tracks daily metrics such as step counts and heart rate.
The goal of this study is to determine whether this digital support helps patients incorporate more movement into their daily routine. We are also examining if the training improves overall quality of life, reduces pain, and helps patients feel more confident in moving their bodies. Participants will use the app for three months and will be followed up for a total of six months. This project is strictly for scientific research and has no commercial interests.

interventions.name: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis or psoriatic arthritis receive the Withings smartwatch and the RheumaFit exercise app for 12 weeks of digital exercise training.
Patients with rheumatoid arthritis or psoriatic arthritis receive the Withings smartwatch for 12 weeks.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with rheumatoid arthritis or psoriatic arthritis fulfilling the ACR/EULAR classification criteria, written informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy
Changes in pharmacological therapy within the last 3 months
